text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 11 · 魔法学院草药温室.
Environment:  Original magical academy herbology greenhouse, gently arched aged cream-painted iron framework and slightly misted clear glass panes, long oak potting benches along both sides, terracotta pots, delicate silvery ferns and rare translucent pale-green leaves catching daylight. Broad clear central aisle toward open arched glass door, orderly jars and folded linen gardening cloths. Plants are purely botanical with NO faces, eyes, mouths, limbs, humanoid roots or sentient creatures. Bright soft daylight, tangible cinematic practical set, subtle wonder rather than neon effects, no crests or franchise emblems.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 11 · 魔法学院草药温室. Create ONE clear TRUE FLAT 2D floor plan or outdoor site plan reconstructing this exact reference scene, for staging and spatial understanding. Show only this location and immediate footprint, not a whole unrelated complex. Preserve distinctive architecture, openings, landmarks and furniture positions. Infer unseen bounds conservatively, mark inferred extension dashed. Black technical lines on white, pale zone fills, wall thickness, door arcs, windows, furniture horizontal footprint symbols, outdoor paths/water/terrain where relevant. North arrow is conceptual sheet orientation. No perspective, no raised walls, no fake dimension/scale numbers, no people or animals. Small English zone labels, title CONCEPT PLAN, large uncluttered plan. Good proportions and connected walkable passages. Landscape format.
